AUTH_TOKEN_INVALID: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
AUTH_TOKEN_MISSING: Authentication is required. Please sign in.
FORBIDDEN: You don't have permission to do that.
FORBIDDEN_NO_ARTIST: Your account is not linked to an artist profile yet.
FORBIDDEN_JOURNALIST_ONLY: Only journalists can perform this action.
NOT_FOUND: The requested item could not be found.
UPLOAD_TOO_LARGE: The file is too large. Please choose a smaller file.
UPLOAD_WRONG_TYPE: This file type is not supported.
UPLOAD_NO_FILE: No file was attached. Please select a file and try again.
UPLOAD_PARSE_FAILED: The file could not be read. Please try again.
STORAGE_QUOTA_EXCEEDED: Your storage quota is full. Please contact support.
VALIDATION_ERROR: Some fields contain invalid values. Please check the form.
RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Please wait a moment and try again.
EMAIL_SEND_FAILED: Your message could not be sent. Please try again later.
EMAIL_NOT_CONFIGURED: The email service is not available at this time.
EXTERNAL_API_ERROR: An external service is currently unavailable. Please try again later.
APIFY_NOT_CONFIGURED: Apify is not configured. Add your Apify API token under Admin → API Keys.
APIFY_NO_TARGETS: No visible artists or releases with a Spotify link were found to sync.
APIFY_BUDGET_EXCEEDED: Monthly Apify free budget exhausted. Try again next month or reduce the sync scope.
APIFY_RUN_FAILED: Spotify play-count scrape failed on Apify. Check the Apify Console for run details.
APIFY_TIMEOUT: The Apify scrape timed out before finishing. Partial progress may be saved; re-run to continue.
SERVER_ERROR: Unexpected server error while processing this request.
CONFIG_ERROR: This feature is not set up on the server: a required setting is missing or invalid. Tell the label team.
DB_ERROR: The database could not complete this operation.
UPLOAD_EXCEEDS_SERVER_LIMIT: “{filename}” is {size}; the maximum is {limit}. Reduce the file size.
UPLOAD_REJECTED_BY_PLATFORM: “{filename}” is {size}; the maximum is {limit}. Reduce the file size.
UPLOAD_CONNECTION_LOST: Connection to the server dropped during the upload of “{filename}”. Check your internet connection.
UPLOAD_UNREADABLE_RESPONSE: Upload of “{filename}”: the server answered HTTP {status} without error details. Send the time of the upload to the label team.
ERROR_REFERENCE: Error ID: {errorId} (send it to the label team).
RESPONSE_UNREADABLE: The server answered HTTP {status} without error details. Send the time of the request to the label team.
ARTISTS_LOAD_FAILED: The artist list could not be loaded from the database. Retry; if it keeps failing, check Admin → System → Log Manager.
AI_DISABLED: The AI assistant is turned off. An admin can enable it under Admin → AI Assistant.
AI_NOT_CONFIGURED: The NVIDIA API key is missing. Add it under Admin → API Keys, then run Test Connection.
AI_BUDGET_EXCEEDED: The AI token budget for this request is used up. Wait for the next period or ask an admin to raise the limit.
AI_PROVIDER_INVALID_KEY: NVIDIA rejected the API key. Replace the key under Admin → API Keys and run Test Connection.
AI_PROVIDER_MODEL_UNAVAILABLE: The requested NVIDIA model is not available. Check Admin → AI Assistant → Models.
AI_PROVIDER_RATE_LIMITED: NVIDIA rate-limited this request. Wait and try again; if it keeps happening, lower usage.
AI_PROVIDER_TIMEOUT: The NVIDIA request timed out. Retry the question; if it keeps failing, try the fast model.
AI_PROVIDER_NETWORK_ERROR: The NVIDIA endpoint could not be reached. Check connectivity and retry.
AI_PROVIDER_TLS_ERROR: The NVIDIA TLS connection failed. Retry later; if it continues, tell the label team.
AI_PROVIDER_INVALID_RESPONSE: NVIDIA returned a response this app could not read. Retry; if it continues, run Test Connection.
AI_PROVIDER_TOOL_CALL_UNSUPPORTED: This NVIDIA model did not accept tool calling. Run Test Connection and check Admin → AI Assistant → Models.
AI_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE: NVIDIA is currently unavailable. Retry later; the rest of the site still works.
AI_TOOL_FORBIDDEN: That assistant action is not allowed for this account. Ask an admin if you need access.
AI_CONFIRMATION_EXPIRED: The confirmation for this assistant action expired. Ask the assistant to prepare it again.
AI_CONVERSATION_NOT_FOUND: That assistant conversation was not found or belongs to another account.
AI_EMPTY_RESPONSE: The model returned no visible answer. Retry; if it repeats, switch to the fast model or raise the output limit.
AI_OUTPUT_TRUNCATED: The answer was cut off at the output limit. Retry with the fast model or raise the output limit in Admin -> AI Assistant -> Models.
AI_REASONING_EXHAUSTED: The reasoning model spent its whole output budget on reasoning and produced no answer. Retry with the fast model or raise the reasoning output limit.
AI_STREAM_INCOMPLETE: The model connection ended before the answer was complete. Retry the question.
AI_TURN_IN_PROGRESS: Another answer is already running in this conversation. Stop it before sending a new question.
AI_DISABLED_FOR_ROLE: The assistant is turned off for this dashboard. An admin can enable it under Admin -> AI Assistant.
AI_ARTIST_INVALID: That artist was not found. Select an existing artist.
AI_ARTIST_FORBIDDEN: You cannot use that artist context. Select an artist linked to your account.
AI_TURN_INCOMPLETE: The answer was interrupted before it finished. Retry the question to continue.
AI_UNAVAILABLE_ARTIST: The assistant is currently unavailable. Your label has been informed of the problem.
AI_UNAVAILABLE_STAFF: The assistant cannot connect right now. The label team has been informed.
AI_UNAVAILABLE_ADMIN: The assistant cannot connect right now. The technical configuration needs to be checked.
AI_RETRY_ARTIST: The assistant could not finish an answer. Try again.
AI_RETRY_STAFF: The assistant could not finish an answer. Try again.
AI_RETRY_ADMIN: The assistant could not finish an answer. Retry; if it keeps happening, check the technical configuration.
AI_DISABLED_ARTIST: The assistant is not available in your portal. Ask your label contact.
AI_DISABLED_STAFF: The assistant is not available in this dashboard. Ask an admin to enable it.
AI_DISABLED_ADMIN: The assistant is turned off. Enable it in the technical AI settings.
AI_ACCESS_ARTIST: Your account cannot use this action. Ask your label contact if you need it.
AI_ACCESS_STAFF: Your account cannot use this action. Ask an admin if you need it.
AI_LIMIT_ARTIST: The current usage limit is reached. Try again later or ask your label contact.
AI_LIMIT_STAFF: The usage limit for this request is reached. Try again later.
AI_LIMIT_ADMIN: The usage limit for this request is reached. Wait or adjust the limit in the technical AI settings.
ERROR_BOUNDARY_TITLE: This part of the page could not be loaded
ERROR_BOUNDARY_BODY: Your data is safe. Reload the page to try again. If it keeps happening, send the reference below to the label team.
